purpose: Test information in within-day waveform timing and cross-family phase relations beyond original daily HNE
selection: Existing participant folds and validation AUROC; original labels and daily HNE unchanged
controls: Original HNE, HNE plus raw within-day history only, full raw/context-adjusted harmonic history and pair relations, history HGB given the same raw rhythm features
interpretation: Observed 24-hour waveform and its deviation; not an independently measured endogenous circadian phase
college_mapping: Eight existing state channels with hourly fields; actual hourly maximum-campus-distance as context; existing daily nine-state/four-context HNE retained
test_status: Only development and College train/validation may be constructed before all models are frozen
